_comment_subscriptions: Inventory is gathered from ALL of these subscriptions (VMs like rrsgncusg-* live in a different sub than the rrwvd/rrwewvd fleet). Names or IDs both work.
_comment_threshold: Uptime ABOVE this many minutes gets the '(Extended)' suffix + yellow highlight. Set to the 9h scheduled session + a 10-minute grace = 550. Override per resource-group or per region below; the most specific match wins (vm name > resourceGroup > region > default).
_comment_workbook: Path to the workbook to update and the sheet to write into. Leave sheet null to auto-pick the sheet matching the target month (e.g. 'Jun 26').
_comment_metric: Azure Monitor metric used as the 'is it running' heartbeat. A VM only emits platform metrics while powered on, so the count of non-null PT1M buckets equals minutes powered on.
_comment_skip: VM-name prefixes in the sheet that are NOT Azure VMs (e.g. placeholder rows). Rows whose VM name starts with one of these are left untouched and reported. Empty = track everything.
_comment_deleted: For a sheet row whose VM is no longer in the live inventory (deprovisioned), uptime is reconstructed from the Azure Activity Log (~90-day retention) by pairing start/deallocate events. Each subscription in 'subscriptions' is tried against these resource groups.
